title: Add Status Filter to List/Tree Commands
description: Extend all list and tree commands with a filter for status. Support both --open and --status open syntax. Different meanings: bundles shows bundles where at least one ticket/todo is open, tickets filters by status. Also extend goals to have a bundle field.
summary: Added status filter flags (--open, --closed, --status) to all list and tree commands (ticket, goal, bundle). For bundles, 'open' filters to bundles that have at least one open ticket. Also added 'bundle' field to Goal struct with --bundle flag in goal open command and GraphQL schema support.
